purpose: Fail-closed isolated persistence anchored to GitHub-returned blob identity.

first_tool_sequence: update heartbeat IN_PROGRESS using fresh SHA
re-fetch heartbeat and verify current RUN_ID and automation_id
write/re-fetch checkpoint BOOTSTRAPPED before substantive work

closure.pass_8: freeze complete RUN_CORE into checkpoint FROZEN_FOR_FINALIZATION and re-fetch
closure.pass_9: create/re-fetch immutable core/<RUN_ID>.json and history/<RUN_ID>.json; use GitHub blob SHAs
closure.pass_10: write/re-fetch latest.json; create/re-fetch immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json binding current core/history/latest blob SHAs; then checkpoint FINALIZED and heartbeat IDLE/FINALIZED

foreign_writer_rule: Any artifact written under the old omega_stack namespace or by an automation_id not listed in isolated control_plane.active[] is non-authoritative for omega_stack_native_v2.
